title: drynaria rigidula f. cristata
intro: Drynaria rigidula f. cristata, commonly known as the "Hairy Venus's Hair Grass," is a type of fern native to tropical Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, as well as its potential to boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Drynaria rigidula f. cristata include polysaccharides, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
